about: Flexarr's design tokens (docs/design.md). `make tokens` writes them out for every client; never edit the generated files.

room.use: Base background: a dim, plum-tinted screening room

seatRaised.use: A surface on a surface: a menu over a panel

silver.use: Fallback accent when a title has no ambient colour

go.use: Connected, on, set up, downloaded, in the library

danger.use: Destructive actions and error messages, never decoration

record.use: The live and recording dot on Live TV, nothing else

well.use: Inside text fields and menus, below the panel

mainButton.use: The main button's fill: the ambient colour mixed with screen, so a dark or dull title colour still reads
